description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git apply' command with various whitespace and configuration options. It contains setup procedures, handcrafted patch files, and multiple test cases to verify the behavior of applying patches under different whitespace handling configurations.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: A shell function that checks the content of a given patch application result file for whitespace correctness and expected content, outputting messages based on the findings.
